_doc: ledger 0082 'Far ground (0.1.11)': Milford's bare ground off the 2017 USGS 3DEP lidar (USGS_LPC_MI_31Co_Oakland_2016_LAS_2019, flown 2017-05-03; pass 2's 71 EPT nodes as the vegetation pass read them) by tracks/milford-road-course-lm/source/far_ground/scripts/far_ground_product.py (its header says how): far_ground.lidar.npy row 0 = SOUTH, column 0 = WEST, each value the NAVD88 metres at its cell's centre (x0 + (i + 0.5) cell, y0 + (j + 0.5) cell, local metres east / north of the origin); far_ground.lidar.fill.npy 0 measured (a plane through the ground returns within the first radius holding 3), 1 filled within reach or enclosed, 2 beyond the lidar's reach; far_ground.lidar.reach.npy each beyond cell's distance in from the reach, m.
